hookText: POV: You caught the inn's new maid in the quiet corridor...
voiceoverScript: In the still morning light, as the soft sunlight filtered through my curtains, I noticed her. A new girl, timid and shy, her eyes wide with awe as she gazed at the grand halls. I was scrubbing the hearth, my hands aching from the heavy chore, when she approached. Her gown was simple yet elegant, and her hair, a light, golden shade, seemed to glow in the light. I loosened my stays and watched as she adjusted her gown, the fabric brushing against her fair skin. I couldn't help but feel a pang of curiosity and a whisper of desire. What secrets did this new girl carry in her heart? Would she confide in me, or would she keep her distance? Only time would tell.
caption:
Morning whispers of the inn.
